मशक maśá-ka, m. mosquito, gnat;
 N. of 🞄a teacher.
मसक masaka, incorr. for maśaka.
मषम् maṣ-am, ad. with kāraya, pulverise.
मसि masi (or ī), incorr. for मषि maṣi.
मष्णार maṣṇāra, N. of a district.
मस् mas = mās, in candrá-mas.
मास् 1. mā́s, n. = मांस māṃsa, flesh (RV.).

मास् 2. mā́s, m. [measurer of time: √ mā], 🞄moon (in. pl. mādbhíḥ, RV.);
 month.
मसार mas-āra, m. sapphire or emerald.
मसीभू masī-bhū, become black as ink.
मासूर māsūra, a. (ī) made of lentils or 🞄pulse (masūra).
मसृणय masṛṇa-ya, den. P. make soft or 🞄smooth: pp. ita.
मस्करिन् maskar-in, m. (having a bamboo: 🞄*maskara), mendicant monk.
मस्तिष्क mastíṣ-ka, m. n. brain.
मस्तु más-tu, n. sour cream.
मस्तुलुङ्ग mastu-luṅga, m. n. brain.
मस्मा masmā, f. N. of two princesses.
माषीण māṣ-īṇa, n. bean-field.
मासीकृ māsī-kṛ, turn into months.
मासीन mās-īna, a. monthly.

मासोपवास māsa‿upavāsa: -ka, m. fasting 🞄for a month;
 -upavāsinī, f. (woman who 🞄fasts for a month, ironically =) procuress.
